description.value: Lynn Canyon Café sits inside Lynn Canyon Park, a cherished North Vancouver natural area anchored by a 50-metre suspension bridge that has welcomed visitors since 1912. The café serves fresh, locally sourced meals and beverages — from bakery items to light lunches — and markets itself as an energy stop before or after exploring the park's trails, pools, and falls. Its emphasis on sustainability and community connection makes it a natural rest point for cyclists riding through the Lynn Valley area.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: wave (5 spaces) at 10m; stands (8 spaces) at 43m. Total: 13 spaces.
